## Description

Select stocks by dividend yield, dividend growth or payout sustainability, often with quality constraints.

## Where it may fit

Income mandates and markets where stable cash distributions are valued.

## Vehicles

Dividend/income ETFs, equity income mutual funds, conservative portfolios.

## Required data

Dividend history, prices, payout ratio, free cash flow, balance sheet and ex-dividend dates.

## Caveats

High yield can signal financial distress; dividends can be cut and yield can reflect price collapse.
